component.name: Ferritone
component.summary: Play and organize your local music collection
Reproduza e organize sua coleção local de músicas

description.p: Ferritone is a music player for local audio files. Search your library, build playlists by dragging files and folders, and resume your playback queue after restarting the app.
O Ferritone é um reprodutor de arquivos de áudio locais. Busque na sua biblioteca, crie listas de reprodução arrastando arquivos ou pastas e retome a fila ao reabrir o aplicativo.
The mini player can show album art, live audio visualizations, and optional lyrics. Ferritone also provides a ten-band equalizer, ReplayGain, and desktop media controls.
O miniplayer pode exibir a capa do álbum, visualizações de áudio e letras opcionais. O Ferritone também oferece equalizador de dez bandas, ReplayGain e controles de mídia integrados ao sistema.

Plays consecutive tracks without a gap, so live albums and continuous mixes sound as recorded. While playing, the position is now autosaved to a small separate file instead of rewriting the whole library, which avoids stutters with large libraries.

Stops after several tracks in a row fail to play and keeps your place on the first one, avoids saving the library twice when playback starts, and makes the dock menu controls open Ferritone when it is not running.
Skips tracks that cannot be played instead of stopping, saves the playback position every 30 seconds, and adds playback controls to the dock icon menu.
